purpose: Resolve reported stability-margin ambiguity before W3b regime labels
issue_statement: Frozen W3a receipt reported Floquet instability bracket I_tonic in [8,10] while summary table showed positive margins at I=20,40 and negative at I=60.

root_causes.description: Period detector accepted period=1 when consecutive states matched within tolerance. Monodromy with T=1 equals the single-step Jacobian, not a periodic-orbit return map.
root_causes.evidence: 28/31 scan points activated W3a-PO with period_steps=1 despite ongoing spiking dynamics.

root_causes.description: floquet_margin_subleading = 1 - rho(second-largest |lambda|). When period=1 and multiple eigenvalues cluster near |lambda|=1, subleading selection is unstable and produces alternating stable/unstable labels across adjacent I_tonic.

When W3a-PO inactive (syn~0), local_step_jacobian margin was used. At I=4, syn=0 but rho(step)=1.18 produced negative margin without an active orbit—this is local step sensitivity at a drifting non-equilibrium point, not Floquet stability.
2x2 reduced inequality remained satisfied while full Floquet (period=1 proxy) flagged instability. Confirms reduced J_red is explanatory only in active regime, not a stability classifier.

receipt_forensics_summary.I_0_to_8: PO inactive or period=1; margins ~0.001 from step Jacobian (near-critical silent rest)
receipt_forensics_summary.I_10_26_60: period=1 PO with rho_sub>1 flagged unstable
receipt_forensics_summary.I_12_to_24_34_38_40_44_58: period=1 PO with rho_sub<1 flagged stable despite same detector—artifact
receipt_forensics_summary.interpretation: Alternating stable/unstable at moderate I is not a physical multi-crossing; it is metric noise from period=1 misidentification.

period_validation.note: If no validated periodic orbit, do not assign S/C/U from Floquet; use D if inactive or PO-unavailable.

corrected_margin_definition_for_W3b.dormant_class: When mean_syn <= 1e-3, regime D uses no Floquet label (feedback dormant).

preserved_W3a_scientific_conclusions: Active drive increases |b_HW| and L_HDP monotonically in mean syn.
Nominal parameters do not yield a clearly robust active stable window under corrected Floquet; many apparent stable points were period-1 artifacts.
Stronger activity (high I_tonic) tends toward instability when period=1 proxy is used; corrected W3b must re-evaluate.
W3b_blocking_rule: W3b regime labels must use corrected m_F and validated period>=2 only. Do not import uncorrected floquet_margin_subleading from W3a receipt for domain mapping.
